h: Torah Fire Heals Those Who Receive It Humbly

p: "This is the law of the olah:
it is the olah on its pyre."
In the holy Zohar (Ra'aya Mehemna, III 28b):
(וַיִּקְרָא ו, ו) אֵשׁ תָּמִיד תּוּקַד עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ
(Vayikra 6:6) "A constant fire shall burn on the altar":
'Is not My word like fire, etc.'"
And in the Midrash Rabbah and Tanchuma
it expounds "it is the olah on its pyre"
is judged only with fire, until:
and given over to the burning fire.'"
And in truth it is all one,
as it says in the Gemara (Sanhedrin 99a):
He said to him: It is a pasuk (Yeshayahu 60:2):
'For behold, darkness will cover the earth,
but upon you Hashem will shine, etc.'"
For of the future it is written (Malachi 3:19-20):
and the coming day will set them ablaze, etc.;
but for you who fear My Name will shine
And it says in the Gemara (Nedarim 8b):
"There is no Gehinnom in the World to Come;
takes the sun out of its sheath:
the tzaddikim are healed by it
and the wicked are judged by it,
as it says, 'and will shine, etc.'"
"For Hashem Elokim is a sun and a shield."
That is, the Torah is called fire,
"from His right hand a fiery law for them";
and it says in the holy Zohar (Beshalach, II 60a):
דְּקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא תּוֹרָה אִיקְרֵי וְכוּ׳
that HaKadosh Baruch Hu is called Torah," etc.,
וְאֵין תּוֹרָה אֶלָּא קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
and the Torah is none other than HaKadosh Baruch Hu.
And when Hashem Yisbarach opens the light of the Torah,
and the wicked are judged by it.
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ לד, ב)
as is written in the holy Zohar (this parsha, III 34b),
and so it is called in the Gemara (Pesachim 54a)
Now it says in the Midrash
that the wicked are judged in Gehinnom
and so it is (in Shemos Rabbah, chapter 14):
(בְּרֵאשִׁית א, ב) וְחֹשֶׁךְ עַל פְּנֵי תְהוֹם
(Bereishis 1:2) 'and darkness on the face of the deep':
so that its smoke is gathered within it."
"and given over to the burning fire."
that they weep and shed tears
like the spring of the shissin, etc.,
and accept the judgment upon themselves as just;
and through this they extinguish the fire of Gehinnom,
and from the fire there is made for them
And so the Torah is fire,
and when HaKadosh Baruch Hu opens
then the tzaddikim are healed by it,
who are the wicked of the idolaters,
And this is "it is the olah on its pyre,"
on the head of the goat:
וְזֶהוּ וְלִהַט אוֹתָם הַיּוֹם הַבָּא וְגוֹ׳
And this is "and the coming day will set them ablaze, etc.,
"but for you who fear My Name will shine
וּפָסוּק זֶה נִדְרָשׁ בַּגְּמָרָא (תַּעֲנִית ח, ב)
And this pasuk is expounded in the Gemara (Taanis 8b)
who are "those who fear My Name":
that they are bound at the root
"and our will is to do Your will,
and the subjugation by the kingdoms";
and they are healed by it.
attain lowliness and a broken heart;
only in one whose mind is humble,
for it is compared to water,
"The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit";
and it opened "this is the law of the olah,"
is as though he offered an olah.
and regarding the nations of the world it is expounded
that all the haughty are judged with fire;
and this is "the wicked are judged by it."
And it says further in the Gemara (Nedarim 8b):
but they take delight in it,
'and you will go out and leap
And according to what is expounded in Taanis,
the pasuk about those who keep Shabbos,
it is according to what we said,
words of Torah from Hashem Yisbarach
And this is "but for you who fear My Name will shine
which are the light of the sun of righteousness,
and they take delight in it,
for with Yisrael the words of Torah,
the light of Torah, revives them.
And of Shabbos it is written (Bereishis 1:31):
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹקִים אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
"And God saw all that He had made,
and behold, it was very good,"
about the yetzer hara and the Angel of Death
"If your sins be like the years":
these which are arranged and come
from the six days of Creation,
which is expounded about the yetzer hara and Gehinnom;
which is expounded in Bereishis Rabbah
about the spirit of the King Mashiach;
for with Yisrael it will become clear
that the darkness was for the purpose
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קפד, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (II 184a):
and there is no good except, etc.,
And this is "For darkness will cover the earth,
but upon you Hashem will shine, etc.":
that with Yisrael it will become clear
that through the darkness they merited to declare it,
